# R6.11 — PROXY-CORE-b + BUDGET (manifest 264)

## Semantics landed

**Release modes + deadline (Stage 1a).** `buffered` for non-streaming; `buffered_heartbeat` for `stream:true` — the SSE head commits at dispatch, `: hh-proxy` comments carry the upstream wait at `heartbeat_ms`, buffered bytes release only after the terminal row is durable, and late failures release the surface's in-stream `event: error` (REQ-XC-110). The lane's `nonstream_read_deadline_ms` rides a new `HttpModelTransport::set_rw_ms` — independent of `stream_idle_timeout_ms` (REQ-XC-111).

**§4.8 taxonomy, `max_attempts = 1` (REQ-XC-123/115).** Upstream `>=400` → `upstream_error`, verbatim status/body/`Retry-After` for buffered mode; `Timeout` → `upstream_timeout` 504; head-committed EOF and non-SSE streaming bodies → `stream_broken` (new `forward_raw_capture`/`RawFailure` partial capture deposits the bytes, `complete:false`). Typed refusals unchanged; infra dispositions flagged.

**Recovery + client-gone (REQ-XC-124/322).** A resumed run fences the dead lease, settles every held `mc:*` reservation without a terminal — `model.call.failed{proxy_aborted}`, charged `bounded{lo:0,hi:reserved}` (attributed at hi, `reconstructed` provenance) + `released{lease_lost}` — one batch per orphan; `consumed + reserved ≤ hard` verified at every durable prefix. A client that abandons before release is receipted `released: client_gone` and still charged.

**Catalog identity stop (REQ-XC-119).** `{name,digest,modified_at_ms,parameter_count,quantization_level,context_length,thinking}` probed at run start / `catalog_boundary` op / run end; instants compare (`+00:00` ≠ drift), a real change sets `drift_observed` + `refused_phase_stopped`. `ModelSnapshotRecord.snapshot_id = tags:<d12>@<modified>`, `provenance = reported`. Served-model checks evaluate `served_model_expected` — mismatches ledgered `model.profile.status.changed`.

**§4.4 mechanical spend (Stage 2).** `ProxyAuthorization{verbatim,gate_record_ref,authorized,available,m_ppm,priors}` — missing authorization refuses `missing_authorization` (REQ-XC-004); the allocation cites verbatim + gate ref. Root pool = `A_eff × (1 − m) − Σ prior windows` (unharvested/unverified refuses, REQ-XH-005/120). Per-call reservation `ceil(rate_in·(B+2048) + rate_out·131072)` at the uncached input rate — no-cache planning until a measured `cached_share_ppm` exists (REQ-XC-113/210/116). Slot slices are `BudgetMode::Slice` under the root — `C × s` feasibility is structural at registration; a refused reserve is a ledgered 402 with `requested/available/consumed/premature/classification` (`inconclusive{infra:budget_reservation}` vs `budget_refused`, REQ-XC-126). Only a root-bound refusal emits `exceeded`+`escalation`+`decision{stop}` and stops the phase (REQ-XC-112; serial writer holds the E1 drain). Reported input over the reservation bound halts admissions (REQ-XC-114). `validate_slices`/`slice_floor`/`feasibility`/`refusal_is_premature`/`harvest_window_spend` are exported for the R6.16 carry-in.
